Hello! My name is Luke Snavely, and I am a Presidential Scholar at Robert Morris University (RMU) pursuing a B.S. in Statistics and Data Science, an M.S. in Data Science, and a minor in Data Analytics, with graduation expected in Spring 2027.

I’ve always viewed data science and analytics as a form of magic: taking raw, messy data and transforming it into meaningful, actionable insights. I’m passionate about understanding data, discovering the story within it, and using those insights to support better decisions. That passion led me to serve as President of RMU’s Sport Analytics Club, where I present on a variety of analytical topics each month. I previously worked as an Operations Analytics Intern for Duquesne Light Company, supporting decision-making in the electric utilities industry. Feel free to explore my projects to see how I put my passion of analytics to life.
